name: EXM_CC_AUTH_TRXNS
description: This table contains corporate card transaction authorization data from corporate card issuers.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a corporate card transaction authorization.

columns.name: CARD_BRAND_CODE
columns.description: Name of the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: PRE_AUTH_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the state of the preauthorization, such as a normal preauthorization or an incremental preauthorization.

columns.name: MESSAGE_SUB_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the authorization request type, such as 0 for a normal request, 4 for a preauthorized request, 8 for account status inquiry service, and 9 for tokenization request or notification.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used by card issuer to convert from original currency to settlement currency.

columns.name: CALL_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the card provider calling process.

columns.name: COMPANY_NUMBER
columns.description: Corporate account number assigned by the corporate card issuer that uniquely identifes the company or its business unit.

columns.name: AUTH_TRXN_NUMBER
columns.description: Authorization identifier provided by the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of transaction provided such as Purchase, Mail Order or eCommerce.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount charged at the time of transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the transaction amount.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description for the corporate card charge.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the merchant that submitted the authorization request.

columns.name: CARD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a corporate card.

columns.name: LAST_SEGMENT
columns.description: Last segment (4-5 digits) of the card account  number.

columns.name: CARD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: SHA-256 hashed card account number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a transaction, such as Valid or Invalid.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Corporate card holder's name that is embossed on the corporate card.

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the corporate card holder.

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the corporate card holder.

columns.name: SERVICE_ESTABLISH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of a merchant or service establishment.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code assigned to the merchant by the corporte card provider to classify the type of business.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a person who incurred the expense.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number that uniquely identifies an employee within a company.

columns.name: DOWNLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Status indicating whether corporate card transaction authorization data is downloaded to a mobile device.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CC_NETWORK_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier generated by the payment network for each corporate card authorization request.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the type of authorization as authorization request or reversal request. Accepted values are 0100, 0120 and 0400.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount approved  in the settlement currency designated by the card issuer.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which authorization was approved.

columns.name: MERCHANT_STREET_NAME
columns.description: Street name where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Identifier of the merchant where the authorization originated.

columns.name: MERCHANT_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CITY_NAME
columns.description: City where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_STATE_PROVINCE_CODE
columns.description: State or province code where the merchant is located.

columns.name: MERCHANT_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Zip or postal code where the merchant is located.

columns.name: PROCESSOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number assigned by the processor to bank issuing corporate cards.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUER_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Number assigned by the payment processor that identifies a card issuer in the payment processor's system.

columns.name: FINAL_AUTH_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates if it's a final authorization denoting there are no further incremental authorizations.

columns.name: TRACE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: An identifier that connects initial authorization, incremental authorization, and reversals. This is generated by the card issuer.

columns.name: AUTH_EXP_NOTIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when the notification for the authorization expense was sent from Expenses.

columns.name: AUTH_APPROVAL_CODE
columns.description: The authorization code provided by the corporate card issuer when a transaction is approved.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Date and time when the transaction authorization occurred at the merchant location.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific expense item.
